title: StoryLark brand
description: Identity and look of a StoryLark deployment: names, tagline, author, manifest colours, default theme, font families. Portable — a brand file plus theme.css and assets/icons/ is the whole brand package, and it contains nothing that is specific to where the deployment lives. Addresses, keys and publishing config belong in deployment.schema.json; library shape and nouns belong in presentation.schema.json.

contractVersion.description: Contract major version. The engine refuses a file whose major it does not support; see SUPPORTED_CONTRACT_VERSION in validate.mjs.

id.description: Brand id. Must equal the folder name under brands/ and the Vite build --mode.

name.description: Library name, e.g. 'Story Library'. Shown as the manifest subtitle.

appName.description: App name — document <title> and PWA manifest name.

shortName.description: PWA short_name (home-screen label). Falls back to appName.

defaultTheme.description: Initial theme before the reader overrides it in Settings.

fonts.description: Family names referenced by theme.css --font-* tokens. A family with a matching @fontsource package is bundled automatically.
